outcome: Spatial learning and memory (evaluated by latency, time, and distance to target quarter)
Hippocampus vascular endothelial (VE)-cadherin gene expression and protein levels
Claudin 5 gene expression and protein levels
Tricellulin gene expression and protein levels
cohort: Twenty-four male Wistar rats were randomly divided into control, sham, hypoxic+vehicle, and hypoxic+MSCs groups.
finding: Administering WJ-MSCs after long-term hypoxia effectively reversed cognitive deficits and prevented blood-brain barrier breakdown by upregulating VE-cadherin, claudin 5, and tricellulin genes.
